_comment: Detection rates as measured on the date this file was written. These are a floor, not a target: a class at 0/6 is an honest record of a gap -- no detector in this toolset compares cited source identity, so swapped_citation stays at 0/6 and that is correct, not a bug to silently fix here. The eval fails when a class detects fewer cases than its baseline. Raising a number here is a deliberate act, done only after verifying a real improvement in the detectors, never to make the eval pass.
